name: AARP Wisconsin
description:
Factory-built homes are a solution for affordable,
high-quality, and energy-efficient community
development.

As housing costs rise and construction timelines
lengthen, factory-built housing offers a scalable,
flexible approach to expanding homeownership —
when paired with the right policies, partners, and
financing strategies.

name: Alliant Energy
description:
We use our energy every day to bring our Purpose to life: To serve our customers and build stronger communities.

Alliant Energy Corporation (NASDAQ: LNT) provides regulated energy service to approximately 1 million electric and 430,000 natural gas retail customers across Iowa and Wisconsin.

Our mission statement: We deliver the energy solutions and exceptional service our customers and communities count on – safely, cost-effectively, efficiently and responsibly.

name: ATC
description: We are a Wisconsin-based, federally and state-regulated utility with more than a 25-year history in building, operating and maintaining the regional power grid. Our system spans portions of Wisconsin, Minnesota, Illinois and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, delivering reliable energy to more than 5 million consumers. More than 700 employees work to keep the power flowing, so you have the energy you need when you need it. The safe and reliable operation of our system, combined with the dedication of our people, creates the vital connection between where power is generated and where it is needed.

name: Biodiesel (MEG Corp)
description: Municipal fleets are increasingly looking to green their fleets and operate more sustainably. Biodiesel is a clean, renewable, high performance alternative to diesel fuel that can be used in your existing diesel fleet without modifications. Visit the Biodiesel booth to find out how easy it is to reduce your fleet’s carbon footprint with biodiesel, while using a fuel that supports Wisconsin’s farmers and local economies. Biodiesel is good for the environment, good for your fleet and good for Wisconsin.

name: Bolton & Menk
description: Bolton & Menk, Inc. specializes in providing community infrastructure solutions. Since 1949, we have been committed to improving quality of life through engineering excellence and client satisfaction. From advocating for our communities to designing their dreams to finding funding, we take pride in our work because we live in these same communities. Today, Bolton & Menk has more than 1,000 employees throughout 40 locations in Minnesota, Iowa, North Dakota, Wisconsin, Colorado, North Carolina, and South Carolina, providing services to more than 400 communities and agencies.

name: CEDA
description: CEDA has provided fractional community and economic development staff capacity for rural communities, counties and economic development organizations for forty years.

name: Cedar Corporation
description: CEDA has provided fractional community and economic development staff capacity for rural communities, counties and economic development organizations for forty years.

name: Construction Business Group
description: To assist state agencies, counties, cities, village, towns and other public entities, CBG has collected publicly available information and documents on over 14,000 businesses. Information and documents have been gathered from state and federal agencies, Wisconsin state courts, federal courts, municipal clerks and a variety of other public sources.

name: Davy Engineering Co. & Davy Laboratories
description: Davy Engineering Co. has been providing engineering consulting services for communities as well as commercial and residential development for 95 years. Our major areas of consulting involve municipal water systems (supply, storage, distribution and treatment), wastewater collection and treatment, streets and stormwater management.

name: Delta 3 Engineering
description: Delta 3 Engineering, Inc. is a full-service consulting engineering firm located in Platteville, Wisconsin, specializing in civil and municipal engineering, structural engineering, building and facilities design, grant writing, planning, surveying, and land development services.

name: Ehlers
description: A pioneer in municipal advisory services since 1955, Ehlers helps clients build strong, vibrant and sustainable communities by delivering independent, integrated advice across all areas of public finance. We work with more than 1,500 local governments, schools, and public agencies across five states, placing our clients’ needs and best interests at the center of everything we do.

name: Energy Performance Lighting
description: When it comes to design-build lighting upgrades, Energy Performance Lighting is unmatched. We work with you on the design, budgeting, funding the upgrade, installing and commissioning the lighting, and providing an owner’s manual. Very seldom, if ever, do you get this complete a package from another “lighting” company. Energy Performance Lighting makes upgrading to LED lighting simple and easy.

name: Engberg Anderson
description:
Engberg Anderson is an architecture, planning, & interior design firm with a long history of delivering innovative, adaptive and high-functioning projects across a range of civic design categories. Our team brings a creative and thorough planning and design process that delivers solutions to not only exceed clients’ expectations but carefully reflect the communities in which they are built. 

Our service facilities are combined with expertise in developing mixed use and targeted multi-family housing, sites and urban master plans that transform neighborhoods and encourage growth. We design with future needs in mind.

name: E-Plan Exam
description: E-Plan Exam is a commercial plan review firm serving 50+ municipalities and 1.4 million residents across the state of Wisconsin for every trade. Founded in 2019 and acting under state authority as communities' plan review agent, our 25 top plan examiners — professional engineers, architects, code professionals, master plumbers, and fire chiefs — are experts across the ICC I-Code suite, putting qualified eyes on every discipline under one roof. Every review carries a 15-business-day guarantee, no appointment needed. A 2024 BizTimes Future 50 fastest-growing company in southeastern Wisconsin, E-Plan has processed 10,000+ reviews with turnaround well ahead of state timelines.

name: Focus On Energy
description: Focus on Energy is Wisconsin utilities' statewide energy efficiency and renewable resource program funded by the state's investor-owned energy utilities and participating municipal and electric cooperative utilities. The Program works with eligible Wisconsin residents and businesses to install cost-effective energy efficiency and renewable energy projects.
